arc.fallback: The Three from a Faraway Land

description.fallback: Meanwhile at Dio's castle, Poco's sister is in company with Dio himself. Dio proposes for him to turn her into a vampire, giving her free choice, but at this, she slaps him. Dio merely smirks at this and introduces her to Doobie, who happened to be right above her.

outro.fallback: Jonathan sends a Ripple into Doobie's body; his snakes conduct it and they turn on him, killing him.
Afterwards, Poco reunites with his lost sister, and Jonathan leaves to find Dio in the castle.
